sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** "Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana" aims to provide comprehensive support to the disabled community in Bihar. A significant component of this scheme involves the distribution of battery-operated tricycles to beneficiaries to enhance their mobility and independence.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Aids/Appliances

**Detailed Description:** The Government of Bihar, under the Directorate of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Social Welfare Department), is committed to the empowerment of persons with disabilities. "Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana" Umbrella Scheme, also known as the Sambal Yojana, aims to provide comprehensive support to the disabled community in Bihar. A significant component of this scheme involves the distribution of battery-operated tricycles to eligible beneficiaries to enhance their mobility and independence.
Benefits / Assistance: - Free distribution of battery-operated tricycles.

**Application Process:** &amp;amp;amp;gt; **Registration** **Step-1 :** Applicant have to visit the [official website](https://online.bih.nic.in/) and click on &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[Apply online](https://online.bih.nic.in/swf/swftc/)&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; **Step-2 :** Click on &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[Click here to register](https://online.bih.nic.in/swf/swftc/Register.aspx)&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;. **Step-3 :** Fill out the required details and click on Register**.** **Step-4 :** Note down the user-id and password. &amp;amp;amp;lt;br&amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; **Online Application** **Step-1 :** Applicant have to visit the [official website](https://online.bih.nic.in/) and click on &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[Apply online](https://online.bih.nic.in/swf/swftc/)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; **Step-2 :** Click on &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[Login](https://online.bih.nic.in/SWF/SWFTC/Login.aspx)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; using the noted user-id and password. **Step-3 :** Fill out the required details: - Personal Details - Upload : Photo, Signature and Certificate Details - Validate Email ID - Documents: Birth Certificate, Physically Handicapped Certificate, Residential Certificate, Income Certificate, Identity Card (College / University Campus / Place of Employment). - Finalize and submit application. &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;br&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
